# A strict open obstruction to polynomial/regular heat decompositions

The degenerate endpoint obstruction persists for strictly rank-one-convex
quartics, even when a finite decomposition uses arbitrarily many different
constant mean-converging flows. The proof does not assert global closure
or convexity of the union of those flow classes. Instead it constructs a
closed outer class, proves that the endpoint is outside it, and uses the
pointed ROC cone to control all finite sums.

The conclusion is qualitative in its neighborhood radius. No numerical
epsilon0 or separating functional has been acquired. The full angular /
rational exact-form class remains OPEN and is not excluded.

## 1. Objects and precise conclusion

Let V be the real35-dimensional vector space of homogeneous quartic
polynomials on real2×2 matrices, with ordinary monomial coefficient norm
||F||∞. Write K for its ROC cone and P for its polyconvex cone; arbitrary
convex minor representatives are allowed for P. All integrand summands
are in V. Nonpolynomial integrand cancellations are not admitted here.

    L(xi)=L11 xi1²+2L12 xi1xi2+L22 xi2².

Call L mean-converging if its eigenvalues have positive real parts for
each nonzero integer xi. This admits the actual constant flows used in
the preceding packet without assuming an unstated uniform PDE theorem.
For compatible Hessian coordinates h=(h0,...,h5), set

    D_F,L(A)[h]=sum_(j,l=1)² F''(A)[Bj,Ljl Bl],
    L21=L12.

L acts on output rows in the last display. Write C_F,L(A) for the
symmetric6×6 matrix representing this quadratic form in h, and W(Omega)
for the one representing Omega(B1,B2).

mean-converging L and closed 2-form Omega, whose coefficients are C²

# Governing strengthening: the outer operator needs no trace condition

This supplements the complete proof in `PROOF.md`. Its larger outer cone
has its OWN unevaluated positive distance. No numerical radius from the
main proof is silently reused.

Let H0 be the set of homogeneous quartic polynomials F∈K for which there
exist ANY real constant matrices L11,L12,L22 satisfying

    sum ||Lij||_F²=1,

and a closed quadratic-coefficient 2-form Omega such that

    C_F,L(A)+W(Omega(A))>=0 for every A.                 (E1)

There is no mean-convergence, trace, symmetry or parabolicity assumption
on L in this OUTER class. The separate requirement F∈K is retained.
We do not claim that H0 consists of valid QC/heat proofs. In particular
an arbitrary unstable flow does not automatically prove QC.

The nonzero normalization is essential: admitting L=0 and Omega=0 would
trivially admit every F and would be no proof operation at all.

Every actual origin-regular mean-converging heat part belongs to H0 by
the Taylor reduction and Lyapunov argument of PROOF Sections1/4. H0 is
a closed, possibly nonconvex cone by exactly the coefficient bound (8)
and compact normalized L sphere; the removed trace condition was not
needed for witness boundedness or closure. H0⊂K holds by its definition.

# Provenance, ordinary constructions, acquisition and limits

The accepted endpoint packet in sibling `b_quartic_principle/` is
read-only. Its full35 extremality, exact non-PC cuts, symmetry transport,
all-real averaged acoustic determinant and no-closed-quadratic theorem
are inputs. The present work does not reopen those proofs. Its frozen
manifest is SHA8ab18c2471a8d4b40452120fdc7c540bc6289001c6cc431e5233cb0b9b8aa8e8.

Root supplied the initial fixed-heat witness-closure/pointed-cone idea,
then correctly warned that the all-flow union is not automatically
closed or convex. Root also supplied the six-vector wedge frame and

trace. B independently reconstructed these, supplied the closed OUTER
class repair, literal coefficient coercivity, explicit90-evaluation ROC

strengthening. This is coordinated construction, not a claim of blind
